blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Public Sector Banks Report Zero Locker Theft Cases in FY26; RBI Security Norms Highlighted. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Mandatory security upgrades eliminated physical locker breaches across state-owned lenders.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
PSBs reported **zero (0) locker theft cases in FY26 (2025-26)** (down from 40 cases between FY22-FY25).
Active Lockers: **11,111,077** (1.11 crore) operational lockers across PSBs as on March 31, 2026.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**RBI Security Guidelines:** CCTV cameras mandatory at strong room entry/exit; footage preserved for **at least 180 days**.
**Bank Liability Cap:** Compensation for loss due to bank negligence capped at **100 times prevailing annual locker rent**.
Bank liability for negligence (capped at 100x annual rent) vs natural calamities/Acts of God (banks NOT liable).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
